The problem is the activity offer. `knows.offerable` is empty and `stillBeingChecked` is 0, meaning search_village returned nothing verified and nothing pending. Hale invented "Tiny Tumblers parent & tot" — there is no offerable candidate to name. That is fabrication of an activity recommendation. Worse, it sends the parent to a "program page" (effectively the app or an external site), which is also a rules violation. Because one part is genuinely correct and useful (the registration window), a 2 is appropriate rather than a 1.
